description:
Replace the current top bar format that renders `session>window1|window2` with a clearer hierarchy for the active tmux session and its windows. Explore a presentation that makes the active session, active window, and available windows easier to scan at a glance. Acceptance: the top bar no longer relies on the current flat separator style and instead presents tmux session/window state in a more readable structure.

Plan:
- Review how the current status line is composed and what information is already available from tmux formats.
- Choose a hierarchy that distinguishes active session, active window, and the rest of the windows without adding clutter.
- Keep the bar compact enough to work in normal tmux sessions.
- Verify the final format against the sidebar and popup workflows so they remain visually coherent.
title: Refactor tmux top bar to show session and window structure
